strings.cin.c4.homeward.alexei.split: The Russian sheets. Pjotr’s name lies under my coat.
strings.cin.c4.homeward.alexei.swap: The German sheets. I read them slowly. He carries Pjotr’s name.
strings.cin.c4.homeward.alexei.elena: Pjotr’s list hangs in a coat in Veltrava. I have only the numbers.
strings.cin.c4.number.alexei: Forty-five. The next run. The paint is still wet.
strings.cin.c4.card.konrad: Lindner, Anna. The other half is already on its way.
strings.cin.c4.stamp.lev: If the card goes missing, they’ll look for it with me first.
strings.cin.c4.voices.konrad_name: The Lindner file, with every signature. And with Marta’s name in it.
strings.cin.c4.voices.konrad_protect: No file. But tomorrow morning Ilse will sit in Hanna’s classroom again.
strings.cin.c4.voices.alexei: Four numbers, one wagon. And Lev’s name on no paper I carry.
